evidence_note: The observed policy is the composition of cincta and outer kernel/container policy. bpf, unshare and privileged operations can already be denied by the outer environment; direct socket and metadata baselines establish effective differential cases.

evidence.diagnostic:
cincta 0.2.0-preview.1 (Linux x86_64/aarch64)
Usage: cincta probe
       cincta run [OPTIONS] -- COMMAND [ARGS...]
  --ro PATH / --rw PATH / --rx PATH   Explicit absolute path grants
  --cwd PATH                         Working directory
  --network none|host                Default: none (all sockets denied)
  --compat                           Explicit ABI 3-5 IPC scope downgrade
  --timeout-ms N                     Wall time (default 30000; 0 unlimited)
  --memory-mb N                      RLIMIT_AS (default 512)
  --cpu-seconds N                    RLIMIT_CPU (default 30)
  --processes N                      Per-UID RLIMIT_NPROC (default 256)
  --nofile N                         RLIMIT_NOFILE (default 128)
  --env KEY=VALUE                    Add environment variable
  --result PATH                      Exclusive new JSON result file
  --network allowlist --allow-net tcp:HOST/CIDR:PORT[-PORT]
  --allow-net udp:HOST/CIDR:PORT      Repeatable; IPv6 in [brackets]
  --metadata                         Broker safe rw metadata operations
  --audit PATH [--audit-syscalls]     Exclusive JSONL events/requests
  --audit-max-bytes N                Audit cap (default 67108864)
  --audit-max-records N              Audit record cap (default 1000000)
  --cgroup-parent PATH               Explicit delegated cgroup v2 root
  --tree-memory-mb N --tree-pids N --tree-cpu-percent N --tree-cpu-ms N
  --workspace SOURCE                 Isolated physical workspace snapshot
  --workspace-parent DIR --workspace-diff PATH --workspace-export DIR
  --workspace-keep --workspace-max-files N --workspace-max-bytes N
  --workspace-exec                   Explicitly execute snapshot files
No implicit filesystem grants. Environment starts with PATH and LANG.
Strict mode requires Landlock ABI 6; compat still requires ABI 3 + BPF.
